adjudication.evidence: Original N/E/U shows a sustained ~3–4 mm E and ~5 mm U offset starting near index 448, persisting through ~475, then returning toward pre-offset levels by index 476–480. The E component drops sharply at 448 (from ~-11 to ~-14 mm), stays low until ~475, then recovers to ~-11 mm by 478. U similarly drops from ~-4.5 to ~-6.5 mm at onset and recovers by 478. N shows less clear shift but aligns with overall motion. The interior (449–474) is stable relative to the offset level, supporting a genuine temporary platform. No independent permanent step overlaps this interval; missing index at 436 does not affect onset assessment. Onset offset estimates match observed jump magnitudes. Therefore P1 is a genuine temporary offset.
